title: Generalize relativistic Pauli 2-to-2 collision to arbitrary isotropic nonthermal chi distribution; verify finite-grid conservation and entropy
objective: Extend full-invariant electron-vector χe strong Cχ(p) beyond two-temperature FD trial functions to interpolated arbitrary 0≤fχ(p)≤1, preserving full Pauli, correct Møller flux and inverse source. Test that phase-space truncation/interpolation does not masquerade as physical chemistry or heat. Build conservation/positivity-preserving kinetic discretization only after independent convergence.
prerequisites: Read AGENTS.md, CONTINUOUS-RESEARCH-SPEC.md, GOAL.md, STATE.json, NEXT_ACTION.json, EVIDENCE.md, BACKLOG.md
Inspect GitHub PR #1 head and Scientific verification for last commit eb9de58d and checkpoint
Read actual 5D thermal-FD weak/source in kinetics/relativistic_weak_form_2to2.py and reference JSON and all tests
experimental_design: Implement a callable momentum-distribution source Cχ(p) with exact Pauli fχ(p), fχ(p') and both electron FD directions; no implicit thermal reset or post-step Gaussian projection
Provide shape-preserving PCHIP tabulation with explicit qmin=0, qmax tail/extrapolation policy, positivity guards, and robust nonlinear gain/loss when F~R
Recover analytical thermal FD Cχ(p)=0 at common T as a control even with arbitrary µχ; recover previous integrated thermal Qχ and independent rest test-particle recoil with matched pmax/kmax
Perturb fχ(p) away from FD with an explicit nonthermal shape; measure nonzero collision source, nonnegative integrated entropy ∫(F−R)log(F/R), and Qχ+Qe=0
Independently evaluate unsymmetrised Cχ(p) number and energy moments against weak symmetrised moments; scan p/k cutoffs and interpolation resolutions. Preserve negative leakage.
Do NOT substitute a BGK relaxation gamma before an actual linearized eigenmode and SM physics constraints; check UV cutoff and gauge-required bath species
Once evidenced, checkpoint/commit/push, immediately select next step in this research run
acceptance: Genuine 2-to-2 finite-T collision for arbitrary isotropic χ occupation, not just FD trial functions
Reproduces existing FD result to numerical integration tolerance on identical p/k domains
Finite-grid χ number and total χ+e heat residuals measured, not declared zero by construction
Pauli bounds, entropy sign, thermal fixed point, nonzero nonlinear source and interpolation convergence tested
No physical 86-eV relic, Γ(T), BEC, or CLASS-ready claims
deliverables: new compact results and scientific report
fallback: If nonthermal quadrature too expensive, use controlled reduced kernel and record its failure domain
If interpolation pollutes equilibrium, preserve a quantitative negative control and fix with a measured interpolation study
If collisions violate discrete number, implement a conservative gain-loss finite-volume remap only after reproducing continuum reference
do_not: Do not use Computer Use/user PC without explicit approval, private-repo Actions, force push, merge main, hide failed numerics, or claim work between runs without scheduler.
